ns2:course.label: Avian Medicine and Surgery
ns2:course.description: Avian species represent a significant segment of the companion animal population. Their anatomy, physiology, and behavior are substantially different from traditional species. Intended to provide students with the knowledge and skills required a practice clinical avian medicine and surgery. Diagnostic and therapeutic principles, as well as diseases of companion avian species are included. 1 professional hour or 1 graduate letter. Approved for Letter or S/U grading.
